title: Eye Candy for Today: J.C. Leyendecker Thanksgiving SEP cover
description: Cover for the Saturday Evening Post, November 23, 1935, J.C. Leyendecker. Image link is to the article on ArtNet from which I sourced the image. One of many Thanksgiving holiday covers for the Saturday Evening Post by the great American illustrator J.C Leyendecker. Happy Thanksgiving!

title: Trove of Syd Mead art on DesignYouTrust
description: The DesignYouTrust blog has published an article with a nice selection of reasonably large images of the work of designer and futurist Syd Mead: Meet The Visual Futurist Who Drew Tomorrow…. It includes some of his concept art for Blade Runner. For more, see my previous articles on Syd Mead.
